# Vendored Livox dependencies

`livox_ros_driver2` and `Livox-SDK2` were imported as source from the local
FAST-LIVO2-ROS2 third-party directory. Their upstream projects are
<https://github.com/Livox-SDK/livox_ros_driver2> and
<https://github.com/Livox-SDK/Livox-SDK2>.

The original `LICENSE.txt` files and bundled dependency licenses are preserved.
Build/install/log artifacts were excluded. The driver CMake and package manifest
are adapted for ROS 2 Humble only, and the SDK is compiled as part of the driver
package. `Livox-SDK2/COLCON_IGNORE` prevents colcon from building a duplicate SDK.
No external workspace or `/usr/local` SDK installation is required.

The ROS message package name remains `livox_ros_driver2` for compatibility with
existing rosbag2 recordings. Its messages are generated by this workspace.
The hardware driver is installed too; bag playback does not start a hardware
node. Actual Livox hardware operation has not been tested in this migration.
